workstream: softrec3 (round 3 of softrec): neighbour lists stratified by lineage
seen_before_writing: rounds 1-2 (REPORT.txt, REPORT2.txt, NOTEBOOK2.txt), the boundary workstream's DH reference. Round-3 outputs existing at writing: the zca10 float16 vector file and an empty calib/ directory (job 84802 failed on a diagnostic assertion before any calibration number; job 84861 rerunning). No round-3 calibration, list, statistic, family, locus or score existed.
hypothesis: A global top-K list fills with a gene's closest relatives while the statistic counts genera. Lists stratified by lineage (best match per genome of every other genus, at most a few genomes per genus counting toward support, above an evidence floor) (a) give supporting pairs that link lineages, so families built from them stop splitting by lineage, and (b) lower chance support per genus, so variable (CRISPR-Cas) pairs keep support.

lists.exact (src ex): for every unique sequence (2,547,528) and genome (3,564): the maximum zca10 cosine over the genome's genes and the gene attaining it, by float16 matrix products on one A5000 (exact search; job chained after calibration). Per-genus structure: the entries of a sequence in the genomes of one genus are ranked by cosine (level 0 = the genus's best match).
lists.cheap (src kn): the same per-genome bests restricted to the stored zca10 top-2,000 unique kNN (round 1), identical copies first.
lists.gene lists: a gene's list = its sequence's entries in genomes outside the gene's genus (as rounds 1-2).
lists.floor (deviation from the brief, decided: the brief's start value 0.32 is the random-PAIR 99.9th percentile; a per-genome maximum over ~950 genes exceeds a pair quantile by chance far more often, so the floor is calibrated for the maximum: floor_alpha(G) = smallest cosine c with 1 - (1 - p(c))^n_G <= alpha, p(c) = P(cos < -c) over all pairs of 10,000 random queries x all genes (the mirrored lower tail as a label-free chance model). Floors used: alpha 1e-3 and 1e-5. The calibration reports how often the 0.32 pair floor and these floors are passed by decoy maxima (-min) and by maxima in genomes lacking the query's MMseqs2 family (diagnostic only).
lists.variants: floor alpha in {1e-3, 1e-5} x per-genus cap m in {1, 3, all}: a supporting pair (a', b') in genome G counts for genus g(G) only if both entries pass the floor and min(level a', level b') < m (the support in a genus comes from one of the top-m genomes of a or of b).

statistic.instance: every gene pair within 3 positions on one contig (9,399,310), homologous pairs excluded (identical sequence, or cos(a, b) >= the floor of a's genome at the variant's alpha)
statistic.L: genera other than the own genus with a supporting pair: a' = a's entry in genome G, b' = b's entry in G, a' != b', within 3 genes on one contig; engine convention Lt = L + 1
statistic.rank-weighted on the cosine tail: t(entry) = 1 + N_genes x p(cos) (expected number of chance genes at least as close in the whole database); per genus t_g = min over its supporting pairs of max(t_a', t_b'); W_r = sum over genera exp(-(t_g - 1)/r), r in {1, 3}; rule W >= t & Lt >= 2
statistic.null: within-genome gene-order shuffle, seeds 1000-1002, every order-dependent step after it (as rounds 1-2)
statistic.rule selection: the engine's procedure at the instance level: rules with instance FDR <= 0.01, top 12 by observed count, the one covering most genes
statistic.pool: 2 sources x 6 variants x 3 statistics = 36 candidates

amendment_1.seen_before_writing: calibration only (calib/calib.json and the per-genome maximum histogram of 10,000 queries x 3,564 genomes); no list, statistic, family, locus or score
amendment_1.finding: the zca10 pair-cosine distribution is strongly asymmetric: different-MMseqs2-family pairs P(cos >= 0.25) = 1.7e-3 vs P(cos <= -0.25) = 3.2e-7, so the mirrored-tail chance model is invalid. Model floors (alpha 1e-3 per genome: median 0.229; 1e-5: 0.329) are exceeded by the maxima of genomes lacking the query's MMseqs2 family in 60% / 33% of cases. The per-genome maximum distribution has no label-free valley (chance mode 0.16-0.20, homolog shoulder 0.64; family-absent exceedance 0.40 at 0.30, 0.20 at 0.40, 0.095 at 0.50, 0.042 at 0.60; family-present 0.95 / 0.87 / 0.73 / 0.54).
amendment_1.change: floors become a pool dimension of global cosines {0.32 (the brief's start, also the GPU storage floor), 0.45, 0.60}, selected on odd genomes like every other choice; variants = 3 floors x caps {1, 3, all} = 9; homologous-pair exclusion at the variant's floor; rank weights use t = 1 + N_genes x P(cos >= c over all pairs) (the cosine's expected position in a global ranked list; label-free) with scales r in {100, 1000}; pool = 2 sources x 9 variants x 3 statistics = 54 candidates. Stage 2 (top 4 exact + top 1 cheap by stage-1 score), selection, test thresholds and refuters unchanged.
